summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its voluntary transfer of listing from NYSE American to the NYSE, effective July 9, 2026, under the same ticker AZUL. The company will voluntarily delist from NYSE American by filing Form 25 on or after July 16, 2026, with the delisting effective 10 days post-filing, coordinated to occur after the NYSE listing commencement. This is a routine exchange transfer, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are involved; it reflects a governance upgrade post-restructuring. Watch for the effective dates and any potential trading disruptions, but no arbitrage angle exists.
